name: Sakaigawa (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Sakaigawa village emblem in navy: a stylised device of a crown-like top above a curved base, like a bird.
history: Flag of the former village of Sakaigawa in Yamanashi Prefecture, dissolved on 2004-10-12.

features.role: Sakaigawa village emblem — a stylised device of a crown-like top above a curved base, like a bird
